Box prep now pins the OVH Object Storage endpoints (`s3.us-east-va.io.cloud.ovh.us`, `s3.us-west-or.io.cloud.ovh.us`) to their IPv4 addresses in `/etc/hosts`, refreshed every minute by a new `mngr-s3-ipv4-pin` systemd timer (a failed DNS lookup keeps the current pin; the managed block is rewritten atomically and only when it changes).

This fixes the slow workspace stop/start uploads (issue #385): the in-DC IPv6 path from dedicated servers to the Object Storage VIP intermittently blackholes TCP flows (OVH ticket #723301), starving uploads to ~2-30 MB/s and tripping server-side RequestTimeouts, while IPv4 sustains the full provisioned 1 Gbps (~13 GB stop artifact in about 2 minutes instead of 10-40). s5cmd prefers IPv6 but honors `/etc/hosts`, so the pin routes every transfer over IPv4. `bind9-dnsutils` (for `dig`, which bypasses the hosts file when re-resolving) is added to the box apt packages. Re-run `minds-admin server prep` to roll the pin onto existing boxes.
